notes.title: Quick update #2
notes.content:
Greetings, 

The second quick update is here with such fixes and improvements:

[list]
    [*]Difficulty of all the bosses has been increased
    [*]The damage of "terrifying kamikaze" has been increased
    [*] The behaivor and damage of "the enemy with lightning" have been changed
    [*]The look and behaivor of the blue gun has been improved
    [*]Another typo fixes
    [*]"Lucky shot" achievement has been improved, now you need to be more lucky to get it
    [*]The help info has been updated
    [*]Other minor fixes and improvements
[/list]

I hope these fixes improve your gameplay experience and thanks for your continued support.

notes.title: First update
notes.content:
Hello everyone, 

The first quick update is live now with such improvements:

[list]
    [*]The difficulty was increased
    [*]Several typos in the game menu were corrected
    [*]Minor bug fixes
[/list]

Thanks everyone for your constructive feedback!

notes.title: Devlog #7 - Epic and toxic fight with a boss
notes.content:
Greetings,

In this devlog I want to show you how the combat with a boss will look like. You appear in a large room with a weird contraption in the middle of it. This contraption is a boss who attacks you immediately. There are several platforms around, where smaller enemies appear time by time. Also you can find some places with replenishments for health and ammo. You need to move a lot to dodge the boss's ammo and shoot the smaller enemies which chase you. And of course the main action is shooting at the boss which has a lot of health. 

The video in toxic display mode is here:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nbo3pJgcZ58

notes.title: Pixelpunk XL devlog #6 - Whitish Mode
notes.content:
Hey guys,

The sixth devlog is here. Today I want to demonstrate another experiment with post processing filters. New Whitish mode will be available in the main menu. The player can choose Toxic mode or Whitish mode as alternative to the standart Pixelated mode. I considered that it would be fun.

So, here is the video:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zEKqJ4kfvhE

The main menu will look like this:

[img]https://s26.postimg.org/ewug3eifd/Pixelpunk_XLMenu.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Devlog #4 - Kamikaze and Electroshock
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

The game received a major update in the past 2 weeks. Now there are 2 new enemy types and 3 new weapons for the player. Also the game now has gamepad support, camera shake and lens distortion at high speed, info panels for player's ammo and health, replenishments of ammo and health which drop from exploded enemies.

Kamikaze and Electroshock are 2 new enemies which player will meet in the rooms and tunnels. The first one chases the player till collision and then explodes, the second one - hits the player with electric shock from a short distance. Here's how they look:

[img]https://s26.postimg.org/a431d2lgp/New_Enemies.jpg[/img]

Player's weapon arsenal has been improved with rockets for the right gun and 2 new weapons for the left gun. Next are screenshots showing all the above in action:

[img]https://s26.postimg.org/pcsyqtzpl/image.jpg[/img]

[img]https://s26.postimg.org/8p1godmyh/image.jpg[/img]

[img]https://s26.postimg.org/p01kkorqh/image.jpg[/img]

[img]https://s26.postimg.org/jbv9tt2tl/image.jpg[/img]

[img]https://s26.postimg.org/5i6x4ps7t/image.jpg[/img]

[img]https://s26.postimg.org/fs9c3yxix/image.jpg[/img]

[img]https://s26.postimg.org/5i6x4qn2x/image.jpg[/img]

[img]https://s26.postimg.org/x5jmiu0jt/image.jpg[/img]

Updated gameplay video is coming soon!

Previous 3 devlogs can be found here:
http://www.indiedb.com/games/pixelpunk-xl/articles
